import pathlib
import re
import subprocess

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE
    ).stdout

def finding(location, kind):
    # Only fixed labels and generated numeric identifiers reach output.
    print(f"BLOCK: {location}: {kind}")

def inspect(data, location, classification_unknown=False):
    if re.search(rb"PASSWORD", data, re.IGNORECASE):
        finding(location, "credential marker; confidential review required")
    if classification_unknown:
        finding(location, "classification unresolved; confidential review required")

try:
    staged = git("ls-files", "--stage", "-z").split(b"\0")
    for index, entry in enumerate(filter(None, staged), 1):
        metadata, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, oid, stage = metadata.split()
        location = f"staged entry {index}"
        if mode == b"160000":
            finding(location, "submodule contents outside checked scope")
            continue
        data = git("cat-file", "blob", oid.decode("ascii"))
        inspect(data, location, classification_unknown=True)
        if pathlib.PurePosixPath(path.decode(errors="surrogateescape")).name == "customers.csv":
            finding(location, "classified sensitive customer data; publication prohibited")

    commits = git("rev-list", "--reverse", "base..HEAD").splitlines()
    for number, oid in enumerate(commits, 1):
        commit = oid.decode("ascii")
        location = f"outgoing commit {number}"
        # Inspect the complete commit object, including its message.
        inspect(git("cat-file", "commit", commit),
                f"{location} metadata/message", classification_unknown=True)

        entries = git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", commit).split(b"\0")
        for index, entry in enumerate(filter(None, entries), 1):
            metadata, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
            mode, kind, blob = metadata.split()
            item = f"{location} tree entry {index}"
            if kind != b"blob":
                finding(item, "referenced contents outside checked scope")
                continue
            data = git("cat-file", "blob", blob.decode("ascii"))
            inspect(data, item, classification_unknown=True)
            if pathlib.PurePosixPath(path.decode(errors="surrogateescape")).name == "helper.py":
                finding(item, "helper may contain arbitrary classified strings; masking insufficient")

    root = pathlib.Path(git("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").decode().strip())
    for index, source in enumerate(root.rglob("helper.py"), 1):
        inspect(source.read_bytes(), f"local helper source {index}",
                classification_unknown=True)

    print("BLOCK: publication stopped; obtain confidential classification review.")
    print("GAP: no trusted classifier supplied; scanner silence cannot clear content.")
    print("ACTION: no remediation performed; remediation requires authorization.")
except Exception:
    print("BLOCK: review incomplete; resolve read or Git failure confidentially.")
